label: The canvas
title: Edit the page you are looking at
body: Pick a section on the real page and its fields open beside it. Every keystroke renders on the server, so what you see is exactly what will publish.
points:
Text, links and images change in place
Reorder, hide or duplicate any section
Phone, tablet and desktop widths in one click
imageAlt: The page editor with the pricing section selected and its fields open in the inspector

label: Content
title: Lists live in one table
body: Plans, posts, testimonials and team members are collections. Edit a row once and every section that shows it follows, on every page.
points:
A table per collection, sortable and searchable
Drag rows into the order the site uses
Bound lists show a card on the canvas
imageAlt: The content view showing the posts collection as a table of titles, authors and dates

label: Code
title: Plain Blade, in your repository
body: Every section is an anonymous Blade component with a small YAML file beside it. Open it in your editor, review it in a pull request, deploy it like anything else.
points:
No database and no lock-in
A new YAML file adds a section to the picker
Remove the editor and the site keeps serving
imageAlt: The code view with the sections folder open and a Blade component in the editor
